items.answer: Full-time employees with three or more years of service accrue 1.50 days of PTO per month.

Hybrid employees assigned to a hub office must work on site at least 3 days each week. The specific days are set by the team, not by the individual, to ensure team onsite days overlap and office time is collaborative. The requirement is measured as a rolling four-week average in MosaicOne, so a single unusual week is never a compliance problem.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

Basic life insurance and accidental death and dismemberment cover begin when the medical waiting period ends.

The 401(k) retirement plan has no waiting period; employees may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

The waiting period is not restarted by an internal transfer, promotion, or change from part-time to full-time status, but is restarted by a break in service of more than 26 weeks.

Benefits enrollment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends, so elections are in place when eligibility arrives.

Next steps:
- Confirm your hire date to calculate your exact coverage start date
- Enroll in benefits during week one to ensure elections are active when your waiting period ends
- Review available plans in MosaicOne Benefits

Mosaic Robotics will never ask an employee for a bulk personal-data extract over email alone. Requests of that shape are verified by a second channel before anyone acts on them, every time, without exception, regardless of who appears to have sent them.

If a message asking you to send the employee roster to an external address arrives, do not reply and do not act on the request; report it to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example and delete it.

Recommendation — not company policy: Recognize the warning signals: urgency that does not match the sender's usual tone, a request to move a conversation to a personal channel, a request for credentials or sensitive data, and an approach that arrives out of the blue from someone senior. Pausing before clicking or acting is the most effective defense against phishing.

Next steps:
- Forward the suspicious message to phishing@mosaicrobotics.example
- Delete the message
- Do not reply to the sender

Each employee may claim up to USD 750 per plan year for home office furniture and accessories. The allowance is intended for items that make a home workspace functional, such as a desk, chair, lamp, footrest, adjustable monitor arm, acoustic treatment, or small filing cabinet.

The allowance resets on 1 January and does not carry over. It is available to hybrid and fully remote employees; onsite employees may claim against it only where their manager has agreed a regular remote pattern in MosaicOne.

Laptops, monitors, docks, keyboards, mice, headsets and webcams are not claimed against this allowance; they are issued as company assets under the Equipment & Asset Policy and remain company property.

Items purchased under the allowance belong to the employee and are not returned at separation. A new hire may claim the full allowance from their start date; an employee who joins after 1 October may claim the following year's allowance immediately as well.

Next steps:
- Submit home office furniture and accessory claims in MosaicOne Expenses with receipts
- Coordinate with your manager if you are onsite and wish to claim against the allowance

Mosaic Robotics provides 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave to every eligible new parent. The 16 weeks are the same whether the employee gave birth, did not give birth, adopted, or became a parent through surrogacy or foster placement leading to adoption.

Next steps:
- Review eligibility requirements (6 months continuous service)
- Confirm timing of leave within 12 months of birth or placement
- Discuss leave scheduling options with your manager and People Operations

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees. The cap covers the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above it.

The cap rises to USD 350 per night in Boston, New York, San Francisco, London, Zurich and Tokyo, and for any city during a period when a conference the company is attending has inflated local rates.

Where the cap cannot be met — a remote field site with one hotel, a sold-out market — the traveller books the most reasonable available option and notes the reason. No pre-approval is needed; the note is enough.

Next steps:
- Consult MosaicOne Travel for automatic application of higher caps in designated markets
- Document the reason if booking above cap due to unavailability

A stay of more than 30 consecutive days in another country requires a Tax & Legal review before travel begins. The review determines whether shadow payroll must be opened, whether a certificate of coverage is needed for social security, and whether the employee's planned activities create permanent-establishment exposure.

Tax & Legal review requests must be filed at least 21 calendar days before departure. The request is raised in MosaicOne alongside the manager approval and names the destination, the exact dates, the workspace address and a short description of the work the employee will perform while abroad.

A trip that exceeds 30 consecutive days requires director approval rather than direct-manager approval. Manager approval, director approval and Tax & Legal approval are three separate records and all three must be present before departure.

Employees must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside their home country, must be in good standing with no active performance improvement plan or open conduct case, and must hold the right to work in the destination country for the period requested.

The employee must stay inside the company's rolling 90-day annual limit.

Next steps:
- Submit Tax & Legal review request in MosaicOne at least 21 calendar days before departure
- Obtain director approval (not just manager approval)
- Obtain manager approval
- Confirm eligibility: 12+ months tenure, good standing, right to work in destination

Flights must be booked at least 14 calendar days before departure whenever the itinerary is known.

The standard lodging cap is USD 250 per night before taxes and fees. The cap covers the room rate only; local occupancy taxes, resort fees and mandatory service charges are reimbursable above it.

An itemised receipt is required for every expense of USD 25 or more.

A direct manager may approve expense reports up to USD 2,500. A director may approve expense reports up to USD 10,000. For a USD 3,000 report, director approval with a Finance business partner review is required.

Next steps:
- Book the conference trip through MosaicOne Travel at least 14 days before departure
- Obtain manager approval before booking; director approval is required for the USD 3,000 spend
- Retain itemised receipts for all expenses of USD 25 or more
- Submit the expense report within 45 calendar days of each transaction date

Security and acceptable-use training must be completed within 14 calendar days of the start date. It is the only training with a hard deadline shorter than 30 days, because system access is granted on day one and the risk starts with it.

The full required set for every employee is: security and acceptable use, data protection and privacy, anti-harassment and respectful workplace, and anti-bribery and corruption. All four are completed within 30 calendar days of the start date.

Benefits enrolment opens in week one even though coverage does not begin until the 90-day waiting period ends. Enrolling early means the elections are in place when eligibility arrives.

Payroll setup, tax withholding elections and 401(k) enrolment are completed in week one. The 401(k) has no waiting period, so a new hire may begin contributing from their first payroll run.

IT ships standard equipment to arrive at least 5 business days before the start date. The shipment goes to the employee's home address for remote and hybrid hires and to their assigned office for onsite hires, and it contains the laptop, adapter, headset and, for remote hires, the monitor, keyboard, mouse and dock described in the Equipment & Asset Policy.

Every employee is issued a standard laptop configured for their role, a power adapter, a headset and a laptop bag. The standard configurations for 2026 are a 14-inch developer laptop with 32 GB of memory for engineering roles, and a 13-inch laptop with 16 GB of memory for all other roles.

New hires become eligible for medical, dental and vision coverage 90 days after their hire date. Coverage begins on the day the waiting period ends, not on the first of the following month.

Next steps:
- Complete security and acceptable-use training by day 14
- Complete all four required trainings (security, data protection, anti-harassment, anti-bribery) by day 30
- Complete benefits election in week one; confirm elections at 90-day check-in before coverage begins
- Receive and set up standard laptop and peripherals before start date

People Operations acknowledges every reported concern within 2 business days. The acknowledgement names the person who will handle the case, explains the process, and sets out what the reporter can expect to be told and when.

Investigations are targeted for completion within 30 calendar days of the report. Where an investigation will take longer, the reporter and the respondent are both told, in writing, why and when to expect the outcome.

Severity 1 cases cover immediate risk to a person: violence or a threat of it, a safety incident with injury, a credible risk of self-harm, sexual misconduct involving physical contact, and any matter where someone must be separated from a situation today. Severity 1 cases receive a response within 4 business hours.

Target resolution times are as fast as the facts allow for Severity 1. Where a case will run past its target, the person who raised it is told in writing why and when to expect the next update.

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations at people-ops@mosaicrobotics.example or Employee Relations at employee-relations@mosaicrobotics.example to report a workplace conduct concern
- Reference your case number in all follow-up communications about your case

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. A request of six or more consecutive business days requires 15 business days of advance notice. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

A manager may waive the notice requirement for a request that falls inside the window; the waiver is recorded in MosaicOne with a short reason, and People Operations reviews waivers quarterly to make sure the exception has not become the rule.

Unforeseeable absences — a sudden illness, a family emergency, a transport failure that makes work impossible — are never held to the notice requirement. The employee notifies their manager as early as they reasonably can, and the absence is entered in MosaicOne retroactively, against sick time where the reason was illness and against PTO otherwise.

Next steps:
- Contact People Operations to retrieve your current PTO balance from MosaicOne as of 1 September 2026
- Plan your PTO request with the appropriate notice period: 5 business days for requests up to 5 consecutive business days, or 15 business days for requests of 6 or more consecutive business days

PTO requests must be submitted at least 5 business days in advance. Notice is counted in business days between the day the request is submitted in MosaicOne and the first day of the requested absence, excluding both the submission day and any company holiday on the employee's office calendar.

Every PTO request requires written approval from the employee's direct manager in MosaicOne. Verbal agreement, a message in chat and an email thread are all insufficient on their own; the approval must be recorded against the request so the audit trail is complete.

PTO requests of any length are approved by the employee's direct manager.

Recommendation — not company policy: Your request meets the notice requirement (8 business days available as of 2026-09-01) and your PTO balance covers the three days (13.5 days remaining). Submit the request in MosaicOne immediately so your manager can record written approval before the deadline.

Next steps:
- Submit the PTO request in MosaicOne naming 15–17 September 2026
- Obtain written manager approval in MosaicOne before the 5-business-day notice deadline

You must have completed at least 12 months of continuous service to work outside your home country. As of 2026-09-01, you have 45 months of tenure, so you meet this requirement.

Germany is an approved destination for temporary work abroad.

Your proposed stay from 3 November to 14 December 2026 is 42 calendar days. Stays over 30 consecutive days require director approval and a Tax & Legal review filed at least 21 calendar days before departure.

No employee may work outside their home country for more than 90 days in a rolling 12-month period. Days are counted as calendar days of presence, including weekends and company holidays.

Work performed outside your home country must use a company-managed, full-disk-encrypted laptop with always-on VPN. Personal devices may not be used for any Mosaic Robotics work outside your home country.

IT Security must be notified of the destination country at least 5 business days before departure so that conditional-access rules and travel-risk monitoring can be adjusted.

Recommendation — not company policy: Confirm with your manager and director that they will approve a 42-day stay. Raise your request in MosaicOne under 'Work from another country' with your exact start and end dates and the address of your Berlin workspace.

Recommendation — not company policy: File a Tax & Legal review request at least 21 calendar days before 3 November (by 13 October 2026). The review will determine whether shadow payroll, social security coverage, or other tax arrangements are required.

Recommendation — not company policy: Verify with IT Security that your travel laptop is company-managed, full-disk-encrypted and configured for always-on VPN, and notify them of your Berlin destination at least 5 business days before departure.

Recommendation — not company policy: Check your rolling 90-day usage in the past 12 months to confirm this 42-day stay will not exceed the annual limit. If you have used any days abroad recently, add them to this trip's duration.

Next steps:
- Obtain written manager approval at least 21 calendar days before departure.
- File a Tax & Legal review request by 13 October 2026.
- Notify IT Security of your Berlin destination by 25 October 2026 (5 business days before 3 November).
- Confirm your travel laptop meets encryption and VPN requirements.
- Verify your rolling 90-day balance for the 12-month period.
